note: the search behaves as the phone design describes, and this has now been confirmed on a phone profile with working touch rather than only a narrowed window
evidence:
RE-CHECKED ON A PHONE PROFILE WITH TOUCH, 17 September 2026, build v26.36.7-29ca209.

The first pass was run in a browser window narrowed to phone size. That proves the layout but not touch, so it was run again on a full phone profile - an iPhone 13 - which brings a real phone's screen size, a phone browser identity and working touch. Confirmed live in the page: touch available, one touch point, iPhone browser identity, screen 390 by 664.

WHAT WAS DONE BY TAPPING, NOT CLICKING:
- Tapped the search control in the header - the search opened.
- Tapped into the box and typed.
- Tapped a result line - it opened that record's own page.

WHAT WAS SEEN:
- The search fills the whole screen, measured 390 by 664 starting at the very top left.
- A Cancel action is present; there is no keyboard legend.
- Before anything is typed there are no type chips at all, just the recent list (23 lines).
- Typing 'ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge Brake' shows only the types that matched: All (5), Work orders (2), Parts (1), Purchase orders (2) - four chips, not nine.
- Typing 'Fibridge', which matches everything, shows all nine.
- No Show all link anywhere, and the full list scrolls rather than being cut to five per type (57 lines for 'Fibridge').
- The page never scrolls sideways.
- The prompt reads 'Search work orders, parts...', which is what the requirement asks for.

A NOTE ON THE FIRST PASS: the chips were read with the desktop name for that row and so came back empty on the phone profile at first. The phone layout uses its own name for them. The chips were there; the first reading was the instrument, not the product.

STILL NOT COVERED, and worth saying plainly: this is a phone profile in a desktop browser, not a handset. The on-screen keyboard pushing the layout, the phone browser's own address bar, and any behaviour particular to a real iOS or Android build have not been seen. Those are for the check on Staging before release.
